title: Nonlinear neighborhoods of smooth curves and arbitrarily negative Wahl defects
summary: We develop a theory of nonlinear neighborhoods of smooth projective curves of genus at least two, constructed by gluing products of open subsets of a curve with a disc using nonlinear changes of the disc coordinate. Their zero sections have normal bundles of negative degree and contract to normal surface singularities. For the minimal good resolution $(X,E) \to (V,0)$ of a normal complex surface singularity other than a rational double point, the Wahl defect is defined by $Δ(V,0) := h^1(\mathcal{O}_X)-h^1(S_X)+h^1(\bigwedge^2S_X)$, where $E$ is reduced and $S_X = Θ_X(-\log E)$.
